references.text: Sara is described as a beautiful woman, paralleling the description of Rebekah's beauty.
Rebekah is described with exactly the same expression 'tobat mar'eh' (beautiful in appearance) as in Gen 24:16.
Rachel is also described as beautiful in appearance, mirroring the description of Rebekah.
Moses meets Jethro's daughters at the well—a recurring motif of meeting at a water source that leads to marriage.
Abraham's servant recounts the meeting at the water source and describes the young woman who came to draw water.
Mary is described as a virgin (parthenos), paralleling Rebekah's betulah status.
The verses describe the same event (Rebekah at the spring) as, respectively, a prophetic expectation and its concrete fulfillment, underscoring God's guidance in history.
